products.title: Brazil Cerrado - Natural
products.body_html:
Our Natural Brazil Cerrado Single Origin offers a smooth, full-bodied experience with notes of dark chocolate, roasted nuts, and a hint of dried fruit sweetness. Sourced from the heart of Brazil's Cerrado region, this coffee is naturally processed to enhance its rich, bold flavours, delivering a balanced and satisfying cup. Perfect for those who appreciate a classic, robust taste with a touch of sweetness.

About:

  • Variety: Arabica (Bourbon)

  • Altitude: 800m-1000m Above Sea Level

  • Processing Method: Natural

Flavour Profile:

  • Tasting Notes: Roast Almonds, Smooth Caramel & Dark Chocolate

  • Acidity: Low

  • Body: Full Body

  • Roast Level: Medium

products.title: Colombia - Fully Washed (CO2 Decaf)
products.body_html:
We think we've cracked the code on great decaf! You know that cliché, "it's just not the same"? Our Colombian Decaf changes the game, delivering all the rich, full flavour without any of the sleepless nights. With indulgent tasting notes of chocolate and a hint of fresh strawberries, this decaf is one of the best you’ll ever taste! It’s smooth, balanced, and so good you’ll forget it’s decaf. Don’t believe us? Give it a try and see why we think this decaf is in a league of its own.

About:

  • Origins: Colombia
  • Variety: Arabica (Caturra & Catuai)
  • Altitude: 1500m - 1700m Above Sea Level
  • Processing Method: Fully Washed, CO2 Decaffeination

Flavour profile:

  • Tasting Notes: Chocolate & Strawberries
  • Acidity: Low
  • Body: Full Bodied
  • Roast Level: Medium

products.title: Ethiopia Yirgacheffe - Washed
products.body_html:
Elegant and refined, this Ethiopia Yirgacheffe offers a smooth, medium-bodied experience with a gentle, sweet acidity. Delicate notes of peach and jasmine unfold beautifully, complemented by a bright touch of lemon and citrus. A delicate floral aroma adds depth and complexity, resulting in a well balanced, clean and delightfully crisp cup.

About:

  • Variety: Arabica (Bourbon)
  • Altitude: 1700m-2200m Above Sea Level
  • Processing Method: Fully Washed

Flavour Profile:

  • Tasting Notes: Juicy notes of peach, jasmine, lemon and citrus
  • Acidity: Low
  • Body: Medium Body
  • Roast Level: Medium

products.title: Guatemala SHB - Fully Washed
products.body_html:
Our Guatemala Single Origin is a Strictly Hard Bean coffee, grown at high altitudes where cooler temperatures slow the bean’s growth, resulting in a denser and richer flavour profile. With tasting notes of smooth vanilla, rich chocolate, and a touch of apricot sweetness, this coffee offers a beautifully round, full-bodied experience. Its approachable, easy-drinking character makes it a perfect introduction to the rich and diverse world of single- origin coffees. Ideal for those who seek a balanced yet intriguing cup, it’s a journey in every sip.

 

About:

  • Origins: Guatemala
  • Variety: Arabica (Bourbon)
  • Altitude: 1500m - 1700m Above Sea Level
  • Processing Method: Fully Washed

Flavour Profile:

  • Tasting Notes: Vanilla, Cocoa & Apricot
  • Acidity: Bright
  • Body: Full Bodied
  • Roast Level: Medium

products.title: Rwanda Dahwe - Natural
products.body_html:
This naturally processed Rwanda delivers a smooth, rounded cup with a notably creamy texture.

Heavy berry notes are layered with a gentle yoghurt-like creamy tartness, creating a soft, balanced profile. In milk-based drinks, the coffee displays a velvety smooth body and develops a unique milk chocolate finish, making it an excellent choice for cortados, flat whites & cappuccinos.

 

About

  • Varietal: Arabica (Red Bourbon)

  • Process: Sun-dried Natural

  • Altitude: 1300-1750m Above Sea Level

 

Flavour Profile

  • Tasting Notes: Mixed Berries, Strawberry, Blueberry Yogurt

  • Acidity: Mild

  • Body: 1500m-1700m Above Sea Level

  • Roast Level: Light/Medium

products.title: The Espresso Blend
products.body_html:
Where the Journeyman Blend is our take on an easy-drinking coffee, the Espresso Blend is our take on an intense combination of flavours. A near-perfect balance of sweetness, body, and acidity. Our Espresso Blend uses a medium roasted coffee as its backbone, with some lighter roasts for added fruitiness.

About:

  • Origins: Guatemala (SHB) & Uganda (Bugisu, Mt Elgon)
  • Variety: Arabica (Bourbon)
  • Processing Method: Fully Washed (Guatemala & Uganda)

Flavour profile:

  • Tasting Notes: Sweet Cocoa & Zesty Citrus
  • Acidity: Bright
  • Body: Medium Bodied
  • Aftertaste: Sweet
  • Roast Level: Medium

products.title: The Journeyman Blend
products.body_html:
Our Journeyman Blend is the starting point to your journey into the world of exceptional specialty coffee. While single-origin coffees are justifiably lauded for their distinct and traceable flavours, we wanted to offer a coffee that provides customers both the quality that they have come to know, but also good value.

About:

  • Origins: Brazil (Cerrado) & Uganda (Bugisu, Mt Elgon)
  • Variety: Arabica (Bourbon)
  • Processing Method: Natural (Brazil) / Fully Washed (Uganda)

Flavour profile:

  • Tasting Notes: Milk Chocolate & Roasted Cashew Nuts
  • Acidity: Low
  • Body: Full Bodied & Smooth
  • Aftertaste: Sweet
  • Roast Level: Medium
